releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.73 refines the Home information layout. The Your files, notes, links and more at a glance line now stays on one line, and the greeting, Celsius/Fahrenheit temperature, date and live Bahrain time are placed directly underneath it with slightly larger text. Quick Actions are moved slightly lower for cleaner spacing. Scan, Search, New Note, Save Link, Files categories/search, Notes, Library, Settings and existing Instagram, TikTok and Facebook sharing behavior remain unchanged.
